_doc: Cases where vfm's normalized HTML differs from the suite's, and why. kind: by-design = the flavor differs on purpose; upstream = remark/micromark (which vfm builds on) behaves this way; other-suite = the expectation belongs to a feature or option the suite assumes (markdown-it's typographer, its looser tables, nested strikethrough) that vfm does not claim; defect = vfm is wrong and a todo test in tests/conformance.test.ts states the right output (none open now). A case in this file that starts to pass fails the run until it is removed.

cm-96.reason: A document whose first line is `---` opens a YAML header (frontmatter.ts); a header that is not a mapping is an error.

cm-98.reason: `---` on the first line followed by `---` is an empty YAML header, so no rule is drawn.

cm-608.reason: GFM autolink literals: a bare https:// URL is a link even when CommonMark's autolink is malformed.

cm-611.reason: GFM autolink literals: a bare https:// URL is a link (CommonMark core says text).

cm-612.reason: GFM autolink literals: a bare e-mail address is a link (CommonMark core says text).

cmarkgfm-19.reason: GFM autolink literal corner cases (xmpp:, trailing punctuation, host rules) that mdast-util-gfm-autolink-literal does not follow exactly.

cmarkgfm-20.reason: The suite only checks that the parser does not crash; it prints a placeholder that vfm's HTML cannot equal.

gfm-628.reason: mdast-util-gfm-autolink-literal links http, https and www but not ftp://.

cmarkgfm-17.reason: A single tilde is underline in vfm (UC-29), so ~x~ is <u>, not <del>.

cmarkgfm-18.reason: A single tilde is underline in vfm (UC-29), so ~x~ is <u>, not <del>; the double-tilde cases in the same example agree.

mdit-strike-14.reason: A single tilde is underline in vfm (UC-29): ~a~ is <u>a</u>.

cmarkgfm-16.reason: A paragraph that touches a table (no blank line between) becomes the table's caption (caption-nodes.ts, labels.ts).

mdit-tables-13.reason: A paragraph that touches a table (no blank line between) becomes the table's caption.

cmarkgfm-23.reason: Footnote markup follows GitHub's current output (`user-content-` ids, a section with a hidden heading), not cmark-gfm's older one.

cmarkgfm-24.reason: Footnote markup follows GitHub's current output (`user-content-` ids, one backref per use).

mdit-extras-13.reason: markdown-it drops an info string made of entities; vfm keeps it as the language class.

mdit-extras-21.reason: markdown-it omits an empty language class; vfm writes class="language-" for an info string of one space entity.

mdit-tables-6.reason: markdown-it lets a table's header row start on a list marker; GFM and vfm read a list.

mdit-tables-15.reason: markdown-it lets a table header start with `#`; CommonMark makes it a heading and GFM agrees.

mdit-tables-16.reason: markdown-it lets a table header start with `#`; CommonMark makes it a heading and GFM agrees.

mdit-tables-27.reason: micromark-extension-gfm-table splits a cell at a pipe that follows a double backslash inside a code span.

mdit-tables-35.reason: Expects markdown-it's typographer (an em dash for ---).

mdit-extras-28.reason: micromark accepts a link title that holds an unbalanced `(` when the title is opened with `(`.

mdit-extras-47.reason: micromark keeps the lazy line after a blockquoted link reference definition inside the quote.

mdit-extras-61.reason: micromark does not treat non-BMP punctuation and symbols (𝜵, 𐬼) as punctuation when it flanks emphasis.

mdit-strike-2.reason: markdown-it nests ~~ runs of four; GFM (and vfm) leave them as text.

mdit-strike-3.reason: markdown-it nests ~~ runs; GFM (and vfm) leave them as text.

mdit-strike-4.reason: markdown-it nests ~~ runs; GFM (and vfm) leave them as text.

mdit-strike-5.reason: markdown-it nests ~~ runs; GFM (and vfm) leave them as text.

mdit-strike-15.reason: markdown-it nests ~~ runs; GFM (and vfm) leave them as text.

cm-579.reason: A paragraph that holds an image becomes a numbered figure, and the text around the image is a paragraph above or below the figure instead of sharing the image's paragraph.

mdit-extras-55.reason: A paragraph that holds an image becomes a numbered figure, and the text around the image is a paragraph above or below the figure instead of sharing the image's paragraph.

mdit-extras-56.reason: A paragraph that holds an image becomes a numbered figure, and the text around the image is a paragraph above or below the figure instead of sharing the image's paragraph.
